# fleetdm_certificates (Data Source)

Retrieves the certificate templates on one fleet. This is a Fleet Premium feature and requires Fleet >= 4.90.

~> Fleet's list endpoint is scoped to a single fleet and has no "all fleets" mode, so this data source reads one fleet at a time. Omitting `fleet_id` reads the templates that target hosts not assigned to a fleet, not every template on the server.

~> The list endpoint does not report `certificate_authority_type`. Read an individual template with `fleetdm_certificate` if you need it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List the certificate templates targeting hosts that are not assigned to a
# fleet. Fleet's list endpoint is scoped to a single fleet, so omitting fleet_id
# reads fleet 0 rather than every certificate on the server.
data "fleetdm_certificates" "unassigned" {}

# List one fleet's certificate templates.
data "fleetdm_certificates" "engineering" {
  fleet_id = fleetdm_fleet.engineering.id
}

output "engineering_certificate_names" {
  value = [for cert in data.fleetdm_certificates.engineering.certificates : cert.name]
}

# Look up a single certificate template's id by name.
output "wifi_engineering_id" {
  value = one([
    for cert in data.fleetdm_certificates.engineering.certificates :
    cert.id if cert.name == "WiFi_Engineering"
  ])
}

resource "fleetdm_fleet" "engineering" {
  name = "Engineering"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fleet_id` (Number) The ID of the fleet (team) whose certificate templates to read. Defaults to `0`, which selects the templates targeting hosts that are not assigned to a fleet.

### Read-Only

- `certificates` (Attributes List) List of certificate templates on the fleet, ordered by `id` ascending. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--certificates))

<a id="nestedatt--certificates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `certificates`

Read-Only:

- `certificate_authority_id` (Number) Identifier of the certificate authority that issues certificates for this template.
- `certificate_authority_name` (String) Name of the certificate authority that issues certificates for this template.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the certificate template was created.
- `id` (Number) Identifier of the certificate template.
- `name` (String) Name of the certificate template.
- `subject_alternative_name` (String) The certificate subject alternative names, as a comma-separated list of `KEY=value` entries. Null when the template has none.
- `subject_name` (String) The certificate subject, as an X.500 distinguished name. Any `$FLEET_VAR_*` reference is returned unexpanded.
